scope: source-only audit and migration handoff for every Product Session registry client; no product UI changes

scanner.rule: Any bare or payload-free authorize URI fails the default release gate. Any product-owned literal construction fails consumer audit even when it carries a payload. Web custom-scheme navigation is always rejected. Product branches must consume the package root canonical builder and safe launcher; protocol-owned constants and explicit documentation placeholders are not consumers.

sharedCapabilityTruth.webProviderDiscovery: implemented in safe launcher v2 through EIP-6963/EIP-1193, but product consumption is evaluated separately
sharedCapabilityTruth.metamaskEvm: implemented in the shared adapter with eth_chainId, wallet_switchEthereumChain, wallet_addEthereumChain for 0x1917 when 4902, then eth_requestAccounts; product consumption is evaluated separately
sharedCapabilityTruth.noProvider: safe launcher v2 returns unsupported with official HTTPS YNX Wallet and MetaMask actions and performs no custom-scheme navigation
sharedCapabilityTruth.native: safe launcher v2 requires resolver-first opening of the complete encodeRequestDeepLink request and exact callback parsing
sharedCapabilityTruth.productSession: standard provider connection remains independent when private Product Session is unavailable

runtimeConclusion: The reported ecosystem-wide public connection failure is consistent with the absence of completed product migrations and multiple source blockers, but this source-only audit did not reproduce every public runtime. No product is marked fixed or connected.

requiredOwnerEvidenceSegments.requirement: Exact product owner commit consumes canonical authorize v1, safe launcher v2 and the root Product Session factory; branch consumer audit returns zero; Standard Wallet remains independent.
Exact public product runtime proves registered challenge, approve/reject completion, introspection, expiry, revoke, restart and Retry with request IDs and no local/canned fallback.

Real browser/device proves no extra tab or custom-scheme Web navigation, provider/no-provider actions, MetaMask 0x1917 flow when EVM-compatible, resolver-first native request, exact callback, cold-start pending recovery, replay/tamper rejection and no fake authority.
